general_information.Description: This Specialization lays a primary foundation for experimentation and exploration of video game design, story, character development, and winning gameplay before programming begins. These four courses emphasize the self-reliance and personal expression of the gaming artist, and encourage you to take conceptual risks and develop new modes of expression and form through gaming. In the final Capstone Project, you’ll put your creative skills to work by generating an engaging game design document for a personal game project, outlining the conceptual, narrative and aesthetic elements of your game.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Final Exam (Presentation) 3) Final Result (TE) =min (10, (TE+Bonus)) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

description: This Specialization lays a primary foundation for experimentation and exploration of video game design, story, character development, and winning gameplay before programming begins. These four courses emphasize the self-reliance and personal expression of the gaming artist, and encourage you to take conceptual risks and develop new modes of expression and form through gaming. In the final Capstone Project, you’ll put your creative skills to work by generating an engaging game design document for a personal game project, outlining the conceptual, narrative and aesthetic elements of your game.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand primary concepts of gaming, and an exploration of how these basic concepts affect the way gamers interact with our games.
Understand what defines a “game” and the mechanics and rules behind different types of games.
Examine how storytelling acts as a vital mechanism for driving video gameplay forward.
Understand game story flows and the strategic elements of gameplay.
Investigate key components of environment and level design.
Create successful character designs that can be applied to video games

assessments.Grading Guide: A student is writing an essay, describing the creative process of how a game works based on the available data of an exam. This includes a description of the characters' features, the development of the storyline, and how the game operates
assessments.Note: Students are not allowed to use document/information in any form in exam room
